name: Yodo
source:
Yodo is a chūnin-level kunoichi of Sunagakure. She is a member of Team Shinki. Yodo is extremely confident with a keen gleam in her eyes. She also has no problem showing the extent of her true abilities. Yodo is a fair-skinned girl with blonde hair. She has a large bang that partially covers her forehead protector. Yodo has blue eyes, which are accented by red markings and she wears pink lipstick. By whipping her hair at a target, Yodo can generate a powerful sonic boom, capable of both disoriented an opponent from its high-frequency nature and physically harm them.

[In game description]
